# feat(hfp-007): delete a Project from the project list

## Task

Let a researcher delete a Project from the project list on `/`. `DELETE /api/projects/:id` already exists and is tested (HFP-005), but the app has no delete call and the list has no delete action. The delete cascades to everything in the Project (transcripts, segments, excerpts, tags, insights, job cards), so the UI asks for confirmation first.

This also meets the privacy constraint that a Project's data can actually be deleted (CLAUDE.md, ADR 0001).

## Parent Story

Hosted-first pivot (ADR 0001). Follows HFP-005 (#24), the first API slice.

## Acceptance Criteria

### API client and store
- [ ] `projectsApi.deleteProject(id)` sends `DELETE /api/projects/:id`; the shared `request` helper accepts a 204 with no body.
- [ ] `useProjectsStore().remove(id)` drops the Project from the list only after the API confirms. A 404 counts as success (already gone); any other error is rethrown and the Project stays.

### UI
- [ ] Each row on the project list has a Delete button beside the link (not inside it), labelled "Delete project <name>" for screen readers.
- [ ] Clicking it opens a modal confirmation (native `<dialog>`, reusable `ConfirmDialog` component) that names the Project, says what is deleted and that it can't be undone. Cancel has focus by default.
- [ ] Cancel or Esc closes the dialog without calling the API. While the request runs, the dialog can't be dismissed and the confirm button shows "Deleting…".
- [ ] On success the row disappears, the dialog closes and focus moves to the "Projects" heading. On failure the dialog stays open and shows the error.

### Tests
- [ ] API client, store and view specs cover the cases above; `ConfirmDialog` has its own spec. jsdom lacks `showModal()`/`close()`, so specs use a small polyfill.

### Docs
- [ ] `notes/progress.md` entry and `notes/task-list.md` updated.

## Known limitation

Deleting a Project whose Participants have Segments fails today (FK `segments.participant_id` is `NO ACTION`; see `notes/task-list.md`). Not reachable from the UI until transcript upload exists; the fix is a separate migration.
